stages.name: pre_due
stages.template: Hi {name}, friendly reminder: {invoice_no}, Rs {balance}, is due {due_date}.

stages.name: due_day
stages.template: Hi {name}, {invoice_no} is due today. Please pay Rs {balance}.

stages.name: soft_followup
stages.template: Hi {name}, {invoice_no} has Rs {balance} outstanding since {due_date}. Please pay today.

stages.name: firm_followup
stages.template: Hi {name}, please settle {invoice_no}: Rs {balance}. Your salesperson will follow up.

stages.name: final_notice
stages.template: Final reminder for {invoice_no}: Rs {balance} remains unpaid. Your account has been escalated to our manager.
